topic: Introduction to Holomorphic Dynamics: Iterating Complex Functions

sections.title: Prerequisites & The Complex Plane
lecture_lines: Complex numbers are points in the plane.
Consider the simple map f(z) equals z squared.
animations: Create complex plane grid lines in light gray #D3D3D3.
Label the real axis in turquoise #00CED1 and imaginary axis in orange #FF4500.
Plot a sample complex point z on the plane using a white #FFFFFF dot [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].

sections.title: The Concept of Iteration
lecture_lines: Iteration means repeatedly applying the same function.
Orbits trace the path of a starting point.
Simple rules create complex, dynamic sequences.
animations: Display z₀ at the origin using a white dot [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg] #FFFFFF.
Animate the transition f(z) = z² + c using a flashing orange #FFA500 point.
Draw a sequence of connected points z₀, z₁, z₂... in bright green #00FF00 [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].

sections.title: Fixed Points and Stability
lecture_lines: Fixed points satisfy the equation f(z) equals z.
Derivatives determine the stability of these points.
Attractors pull nearby points into their orbit.
animations: Highlight a stable fixed point with a blue circle #1E90FF [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/magnet.svg].
Animate points converging toward the fixed point in green #00FF00.
Highlight an unstable fixed point with a red 'X' #FF0000 [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/vortex.svg].

sections.title: The Julia Set: The Boundary of Chaos
lecture_lines: The Julia set is a chaotic boundary.
Iterates of points diverge at this edge.
Stability defines the surrounding Fatou set.
animations: Show a grid of starting values in white #FFFFFF using a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg] to orient the coordinate plane.
Fill points escaping to infinity with dark blue #00008B.
Highlight the Julia set boundary with a yellow #FFFF00 glow and inspect the detail using a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/magnifier.svg].

sections.title: Application: The Mandelbrot Set
lecture_lines: The Mandelbrot set maps all possible Julia sets.
The parameter c controls the dynamical system.
Small changes in c drastically alter behavior.
animations: Display the c-plane as a dark background #000000 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/computer.svg].
Iterate z₀=0 for each c and show escape time in orange #FF8C00.
Display the final Mandelbrot set shape in black #000000 on a white background using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/hardware.svg].
